newsitem.title: USA: Progress sells mortgage servicing portfolio.
newsitem.headline: Progress sells mortgage servicing portfolio.

text.p: Progress Financial Corp. said Monday it sold its rights to service about $350 million of mortgages to Signet Banking Corp. and expects to record a gain of about $900,000 before taxes for the quarter ended March 31.
Mortgage servicers collect monthly payments and distribute them to investors for a fee.
Progress Financial said it decided to sell the portfolio in an ongoing effort to enhance shareholder value and as part of its strategic review of lines of business.
Progress Financial is a thrift holding company based in Blue Bell, Pa.
Its stock edged down 12.5 cents to $8.625 early on Nasdaq.
